in_marathi.name: Devsundar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods, Sun God

vedic_reference.root_origin: Sanskrit origin, named after the Sun God Surya
vedic_reference.note: Devsundar is a name derived from Sanskrit, specifically from the name of the Sun God, Surya. It is a compound of 'deva' meaning 'god' and 'sundar' meaning 'handsome, beautiful'. The name is also associated with the Sun God's various epithets such as 'Ravi', 'Surya', and 'Aditya'. In Hindu mythology, the Sun God is often depicted as riding a chariot drawn by seven horses and holding a lotus in his hand. He is also known to bestow wealth and prosperity upon his devotees.
